BETA Close X Pets At Home Group Plc has purchased 451,377 of its ordinary shares between July 20 and July 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The weighted average price paid per share during this period ranged from 198.8 GBp to 215.0 GBp, with the total number of voting rights now standing at 443,600,645 following the cancellation of the repurchased shares. Disclaimer* Pets At Home Group Plc 03 August 2026 3 Aug 2026 Pets at Home Group Plc Transaction in Own Shares Pets at Home Group Plc (the "Company"), announces that, in the period Monday 20 July 2026 to Friday 24 July 2026, it purchased in aggregate 451,377 of its ordinary £0.01 shares ("Ordinary Shares") through Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch (trading for these purposes as Deutsche Numis) ("Deutsche Numis"), in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme announced on 24 June 2026 ("Share Buyback Programme"). Date Aggregate Volume Lowest price paid (GBp) Highest price paid (GBp) Weekly weighted Average Price paid per share (GBp) 27/07/2026 115,173 198.8 200.0 199.5882 28/07/2026 86,693 201.2 204.0 203.8410 29/07/2026 57,829 205.0 207.0 206.4868 30/07/2026 41,682 210.2 211.2 211.1388 31/07/2026 150,000 209.0 215.0 211.8292 The purchased shares will be cancelled. Following the purchase of these shares, the remaining number of Ordinary Shares in issue will be 443,600,645 with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total voting rights in the Company will be 443,600,645. This figure for the total number of voting rights may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
